major_cooldowns.name: Apotheosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with 0 or 1 charge of each Holy Word banked, ideally seconds after a Halo, then dump Holy Words, Prayer of Mending and Surge of Light Flash Heals into the window for triple Holy Word cooldown reduction.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Eternal Sanctity extends the 20 sec base duration by 12 sec; Sustained Potency adds up to 6 sec more from Halo.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for scripted raid-wide damage and start the channel early enough that the last pulse or two lands as the hit goes out, and do not clip the 5 sec channel.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown 180 sec; Seraphic Crescendo cuts it to 120 sec. Aura id is 64844.

major_cooldowns.name: Guardian Spirit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-place it on the tank before a known lethal hit rather than reacting to the health bar, and call it so it does not overlap another healer's external.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Follow Apotheosis with it whenever you have no assigned window, so the 20% haste lands on the Holy Word dump.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it in the last seconds before Apotheosis or Divine Hymn for the Surge of Light proc and Resonant Energy stacks, and never hold it longer than 30 sec waiting for them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 120517 is the cast; 449840 is the self aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Serenity
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Treat it as rotational and spend it on any injured ally the moment it is up: Flash Heal takes 6 sec off it, Prayer of Mending another 4 with Voice of Harmony, and sitting at the Miracle Worker charge cap throws that cooldown reduction away.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Sanctify
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on any injured cluster as soon as it is available; Prayer of Healing shaves 6 sec off it and banking charges only wastes Serendipity cooldown reduction.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Ultimate Serenity redirects Sanctify's cooldown reduction and talents into Holy Word: Serenity, so builds taking it show few or no Sanctify casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Chastise
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown for damage and, with Divine Image, a few seconds ahead of a known burst of raid damage so the Naaru is already out.

rule.action: Cast Halo in the seconds before Apotheosis so Manifested Power's Surge of Light proc and the Resonant Energy stacks are already live when the window opens. Do not hold Halo more than 30 sec to line them up.
Open the Divine Hymn window with Halo whenever both are ready, so the channel pulses into Resonant Energy stacks. If Halo has already been sitting for 30 sec, send it rather than waiting for Hymn.

rule.description: Spend Surge of Light on Prayer of Healing
rule.action: Consume every Surge of Light proc: with Spiritwell send it into Prayer of Healing for the Empowered Surges bonus, otherwise into Flash Heal. It stacks to 2, so a proc on a full stack is lost mana and healing.

rule.description: Keep a Divine Image Naaru active
rule.action: Cast Holy Word: Serenity, Sanctify and Chastise the moment they come up instead of banking charges; each summon refreshes the 9 sec Naaru and empowers the one already out.

rule.description: Prayer of Healing over Flash Heal on Surge of Light
rule.action: Spend Surge of Light procs on Prayer of Healing over Flash Heal: the group heal gets more value from the free cast and the mana discount. Save Flash Heal for emergencies outside Apotheosis; during Apotheosis, send Surge of Light into Flash Heal instead for the extra Holy Word cooldown reduction.
